metadata.title: greenhouse-watch — Your Board, Your Call
metadata.topic: GREENHOUSE-WATCH — DIFF ONE JOB BOARD, MATCH AGAINST A RÉSUMÉ, STOP AT THE HUMAN GATE
metadata.purpose: Skill teardown of greenhouse-watch: why narrowness is the design (one fetch, one diff, one auditable rule-set), how the six-step pipeline runs, what the scheme does and where it bends, and why the machine stops before deciding.
metadata.description_blurb: greenhouse-watch fetches one Greenhouse job board, diffs it against a state file, matches new postings to a JSON résumé on a documented rule-set, and stops. This teardown shows the six-step pipeline, the NoRedirect fetcher, the baseline→diff state cycle, the scheme weights you can apply by hand, the real Airbnb output (163 jobs, 25 new, 7 relevant), and the gate line that keeps the deciding with the human.
